strings: TITLE PCI-DSS Analysis and Configuration Extractor v2.0 (ATEITISInspection)
REM Some variables to perform query operations
echo ^|=---=[PCI-DSS Analysis and Configuration Extractor v2.0 (ATEITISInspection) v%version%]=--=^|
REM Check if user has administrative privileges
echo --^[ INFO: Administrative permissions required. Detecting permissions...
echo --^[ WARN: The current user has insufficient permissions
echo --^[ INFO: Retrieving configuration. This may take a while, be patient...
echo ^|=---=[PCI-DSS Analysis and Configuration Extractor v2.0 (ATEITISInspection) v%version%]=--=^| >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
echo --^[ INFO: PCI DSS v3.2.1 checked >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
REM export the current date and time
echo --^[ INFO: Report start time: >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
FOR /F "tokens=1* delims=REG_SZ " %%A IN ('REG QUERY HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v Domain') DO (
ECHO --^[ INFO: Computer is standalone or in a workgroup >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
ECHO --^[ INFO: Computer belongs to %Domain% domain >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name=all >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
ECHO INFO: IPv6 NOT supported >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
echo ^|= Please compare current values with your Security Configuration Standard   =^| >> ~ATEITISInspectionLOG.TMP 2> nul
